name: Muu
source:
A mysterious black cat that fell from the sky. For some reason, he can understand and speak human language.

He works as an apprentice butler at the mansion.

[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/akuneko_info/status/1352934099787280385]Twitter[/url]]
